children: S&P Global has downgraded Icade's long-term credit rating from "BBB with a negative outlook" to "BBB- with a stable outlook".
Icade's short-term rating was also downgraded from "A-2" to "A-3" by S&P Global.

"Icade has taken note of this decision and renews its commitment to prudent management in order to strengthen its operational profile and preserve its financial flexibility," added Icade in a statement.
